info.name: WebCA Server API
info.description: Complete API collection for WebCA Server - Database and Broker management system

item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Authenticate user and get JWT token.

**URI:**
```
POST /auth/login
```

**Authentication:** Not required (Public endpoint)

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "id": "user123",
  "password": "password123"
}
```

**Success Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
}
```

**Error Response (401 Unauthorized):**
```json
{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "message": "Invalid credentials",
  "error": "Unauthorized"
}
```

**Note:** This endpoint automatically saves the token to the collection variable `jwt_token` for use in other requests.

Register a new user account.

**URI:**
```
POST /auth/register
```

**Authentication:** Not required (Public endpoint)

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "id": "newuser",
  "password": "newpassword123"
}
```

**Success Response (200 OK):**
- Status: `200 OK`
- Body: No content

**Error Response (400 Bad Request):**
```json
{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "message": "User already exists",
  "error": "Bad Request"
}
```

item.name: User

request.description:

**URI:**
```
GET /user
```

**Authentication:** Required
**Headers:**
```
Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>
```

**Success Response (200 OK):**

  "id": "user123",

  "ha_mon_list": {},

}

```

```

**Path Parameters:**
- `hostUid` - Host unique identifier
- `dbname` - Database name

**Success Response (200 OK):**

{
  "activelist": {
    "active": []

item.name: Get Auto Backup DB Err Log

request.description:
Get auto-backup database error log. Returns domain-only data (CMS envelope removed).

**URI:**
```
POST /:hostUid/database/auto-backup-db-err-log
```
**Example:**
```
POST /host-uid-1/database/auto-backup-db-err-log
```

**Authentication:** Required
**Headers:**
```
Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>
Content-Type: application/json
```

**Path Parameters:**
- `hostUid` - Host unique identifier

**Request Body:**
```json
{}
```

**Note:** Request body is an empty object. No fields are required.

**Success Response (200 OK) - With Errors:**
```json
{
  "error": [
    {
      "backupid": "test_backup",
      "dbname": "demodb",
      "error_desc": "backupdb(demodb): auto job start",
      "error_time": "2026/01/24 15:18:00"
    },
    {
      "backupid": "test_backup",
      "dbname": "demodb",
      "error_desc": "backupdb(demodb): success",
      "error_time": "2026/01/24 15:18:00"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Success Response (200 OK) - No Errors:**
```json
{
  "error": null
}
```

**Response Field Descriptions:**
- `error` - Array of error log entries (null if no errors)
  - `backupid` - Backup ID
  - `dbname` - Database name
  - `error_desc` - Error description
  - `error_time` - Error time

**Error Response (404 Not Found):**
```json
{
  "statusCode": 404,
  "message": "Host not found",
  "error": "Not Found"
}
```

**Error Response (500 Internal Server Error):**
```json
{
  "statusCode": 500,
  "message": "Failed to get error log",
  "error": "Internal Server Error"
}
```

**URI:**
```
POST /:hostUid/database/lock/:dbname
```
**Example:**
```
POST /host-uid-1/database/lock/demodb
```

**Authentication:** Required
**Headers:**
```
Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>
Content-Type: application/json
```

**Path Parameters:**
- `hostUid` - Host unique identifier
- `dbname` - Database name

**Request Body:**
```json
{}
```

**Note:** Request body is an empty object. No fields are required.

**Success Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "lockinfo": [
    {
      "dinterval": "1.00",
      "esc": "100000",
      "lot": [
        {
          "entry": [
            {
              "lock_holders": [
                {
                  "count": "1",
                  "granted_mode": "IS_LOCK",
                  "nsubgranules": "0",
                  "tran_index": "1"
                }
              ],
              "num_b_holders": "0",
              "num_holders": "1",
              "num_waiters": "0",
              "ob_type": "Class = code",
              "oid": "0|201|-32763"
            }
          ],
          "maxnumlock": "10000",
          "numlocked": "6"
        }
      ],
      "transaction": [
        {
          "@uid": "DBA",
          "host": "lgj1089-36",
          "index": "1",
          "isolevel": "COMMITTED READ",
          "pid": "44371",
          "pname": "csql",
          "timeout": ":"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

**Response Field Descriptions:**
- `lockinfo` - Array of lock information objects
  - `dinterval` - Deadlock interval
  - `esc` - ESC (Escalation) value
  - `lot` - Lock object table array
    - `entry` - Array of lock entries
      - `lock_holders` (optional) - Array of lock holder information (only present when lock is held)
        - `count` - Count
        - `granted_mode` - Granted mode (e.g., "IS_LOCK", "IX_LOCK")
        - `nsubgranules` - Number of sub-granules
        - `tran_index` - Transaction index
      - `num_b_holders` - Number of B holders (may be "missing" or numeric string)
      - `num_holders` - Number of holders (may be "inser" or numeric string)
      - `num_waiters` - Number of waiters (may be "=" or numeric string)
      - `ob_type` - Object type
      - `oid` - Object ID
    - `maxnumlock` - Maximum number of locks
    - `numallocated` (optional) - Number of allocated locks (may not be present)
    - `numlocked` - Number of locked objects
    - `sizelock` (optional) - Size of lock (may not be present)
  - `transaction` - Array of transaction information
    - `@uid` - User ID
    - `host` - Host name
    - `index` - Transaction index
    - `isolevel` - Isolation level
    - `pid` - Process ID
    - `pname` - Process name
    - `timeout` - Timeout

**Error Response (404 Not Found):**
```json
{
  "statusCode": 404,
  "message": "Host not found",
  "error": "Not Found"
}
```

**Error Response (500 Internal Server Error):**
```json
{
  "statusCode": 500,
  "message": "Failed to get lock information",
  "error": "Internal Server Error"
}
```
